message: 🚨 ALERT: data-pipeline-01 disk full. Pipeline halted.
Checking. Disk is 100% full. /var/log/data-pipeline has 180GB of log files. That's a week of unrotated logs.
Found it — log rotation was disabled on Aug 5 for a debugging investigation and never re-enabled. The config change was committed directly without a revert reminder.
Cleaning old logs and re-enabling rotation. Should have the pipeline back in 20 minutes.
Pipeline is back and processing the backlog. No data loss — just delayed processing.
